headline: Land Use Rights Expire, Supplementary Payment of 70% of Benchmark Land Price: Shanghai Sets an Example
summary: Shanghai is applying a supplementary payment of 70% of the benchmark land price when land use rights expire. The municipality is presented as an example for the measure.
why: Land use rights and land prices shape costs for developers and property companies in China, where local governments sell land and rely on land revenue.
